traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 100 Polygalaceae: herbs, shrubs, climbers or rarely small trees; leaves alternate, rarely opposite, simple; no stipules; flowers irregular, the two inner of 5 sepals large and petal-like (wings), petals 3 to 5, the lowest a keel; stamens 8, rarely 5 or 4, joined in a sheath; ovary free (superior), of two cells; fruit a capsule or drupe-like.

traits.zygomorphy.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Polygalaceae with Emblingiaceae, Xanthophyllaceae: its irregular flowers are of no named kind (pea flower, two lips, orchid lip), read from the coded corolla symmetry (spec-rework/b1/delta): zygomorphy other.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 321, 324, family Polygalaceae: phyllotaxis pattern spiral; read as "spiral".

traits.inflorescence.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 321, 324, family Polygalaceae: inflorescence spike, raceme or panicle; read as {"panicle": "often", "raceme": "often", "spike": "often"}.
